# Upstream source

`openpi/` is an unmodified local checkout of https://github.com/Physical-Intelligence/openpi at commit `215abfb217dbac7d5f1273282331b9b1866c0479` (verified 2026-09-19). It retains its own Git metadata and license. The outer repository ignores this checkout; recreate it with [the documented setup commands](../docs/openpi.md).

Only source and the lightweight client are installed locally. Model weights and the heavyweight Linux/GPU server environment have not been downloaded or installed.
